Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Profile cards now show a player's Ultimate clears, with the parse they earned, and link straight to their Lodestone, Tomestone and FFLogs pages. Clears are fetched once an hour and shared with everyone, so opening a card costs nothing. New Achievements tab (beta): a feed of Ultimate clears and savage tier clears as people get them, with a heart and a share on each. Yours are broadcast by default - turn it off under Settings if you would rather they weren't. Voting now needs the current version of the plugin; older versions can still read ratings but can no longer cast them. The report button has been removed from profile cards, and so has Clear local data.
